$comment: Owning contract: contracts/approval-intent.schema.json per ROADMAP.md §0.4, Paper IV §6.6. Approval intent — the exact consequential action awaiting the operator (glossary: Approval intent). DRAFT 0.1 — built 2026-10-21 on HgX's order; awaiting ratification. Normative on ratification only.

action.description: Exact action (e.g. send, publish, purchase, delete). Glossary: Consequential action

approval_state.description: Lifecycle state of this intent (TLA+ ApprovalStates). The intent record itself does not carry this in the machine; included for serialised intent views

expiry.description: Intent expiry in server epoch seconds. T9 guard requires now < expiry; T10 fires at now >= expiry. INTERPRETATION: epoch-seconds integer (matches the machine's guards); Appendix C.2 sketch names this field 'expires_at' as a date-time string — recorded as an open question in BUILD-NOTES.md

intent_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialisation of the bound fields (glossary U-1, RESOLVED 2026-10-19). See spec/approval-digest.md. Recomputed by the server at decision time; any mutation fails the match (INV-A3, PO-3)

requested_at.description: When the intent was presented to the operator (Paper IV App. C.2)

revision.description: Intent revision; binds to the work-item revision (INV-A2). Any change invalidates the intent (INV-A3). INTERPRETATION: integer (TLA+ Nat); Appendix C.2 sketch says string — recorded as an open question in BUILD-NOTES.md

work_id.description: Work item this intent belongs to

title: ApprovalIntent
